title: mri_cnr
description: Compute the gray/white/csf contrast-to-noise ratio for volumes using FreeSurfer.

slope.description: Compute slope and write to files labeled with slope_fname. Requires four additional values: dist_in, dist_out, step_in, and step_out.
slope.title: Slope Computation

logfile.description: Log CNR to specified logfile. Will contain 8 values in a specific order: gray_white_cnr, gray_csf_cnr, white_mean, gray_mean, csf_mean, sqrt(white_var), sqrt(gray_var), sqrt(csf_var).
logfile.title: Log File

labels.description: Read hemisphere labels from specified left and right hemisphere files.
labels.title: Hemisphere Labels

print_total_cnr.description: Print only the total CNR to stdout.
print_total_cnr.title: Print Total CNR Flag

version_flag.description: Print software version information and quit.
version_flag.title: Version Flag
